summary: 1. Key operational findings: Water infiltration in the 735 area now caps Stage 4 mining at 350 BCM/day — the tightest constraint figure logged in this KB to date. 2. A pump is being considered but installing it requires stopping mining first; plan is to finish the 735 area over the next two days, then pump out. 3. Wednesday's blast plan firms up: 510 and 517 in the morning, Stage 4 stops after the 510 shot to transfer machines top-side and opportunistically clear the switchback 2A single end. 4. The 164 block is flagged the top drilling/blasting priority on cost-exposure grounds. 5. DR-343's standing "Faulty Drifter" breakdown (open since July 11) now has a scheduled fix: a SANDVIK technician drifter overhaul running 13-19 July, per the newly-read FCST Week 29-30 production forecast — the rig is planned at 12.2% availability for Week 29 (the overhaul window) recovering to 85.4% for Week 30. 6. Equipment running hours, July 12: dump-truck fleet fell to 415.8 hrs on 30,593 L diesel — down 18.3 hrs from July 11 despite burning 1,381 L more, a worse liters-per-hour ratio worth watching. 7. Drill rigs rose to 114 hrs (night-heavy), consistent with the fleet's July 12 availability recovery. 8. Grade Control's July 12 row doesn't reconcile cleanly against Block Info's per-block total for 735-186-1 — same standing block-grid layout issue since the 45th pass, not resolved this pass. 9. A second, previously-unregistered copy of the July Distance report has appeared at a new top-level RAW path (outside the `July 26/` subfolder every other daily workbook has used) and is already populated through July 12 (ore 3.84 km / waste 3.18 km / overall 3.24 km average haul, 374,697 BCM MTD) while the original `July 26/` copy remains stuck at July 11 data. New NCR: HSEQ-NCR-ADW-26-016, a camp bus-park physical altercation between two dump-truck operators (Afraz Azam, Jaffer Vengat) during lunch break on July 12 — the first non-operational-area conduct NCR in the corpus and the first naming two co-respondent operators. Following the KB's 30-day production-month convention, July 12 remains production day 18 of 30 — 12 days remaining. Wiki updates: [[equipment-running-hours-log]], [[fleet-availability-utilization]], [[july-2026-forecast]], [[blasting-and-drilling]], [[ncr-patterns]], and [[daily-production-report]] all updated with new dated sections; all six `Last updated` bumped to 2026-07-13 (57th pass); `Wiki/INDEX.md` refreshed for the same six articles. [[survey-volume-reconciliation]] not touched (already current from the 56th pass). Full detail in `RAW/_INGESTED.md` under "57th compile pass." ---
